aggregate_label: Experimental scenario summary; not calibrated SRL

anchors.1: Explicit categorical opposition to this concern in the current scenario
anchors.2: Strong opposition with a stated boundary
anchors.4: Leans against; conditions not yet met
anchors.5: Explicit mixed acceptance and opposition about this concern; uncertainty without a position remains unassessed
anchors.7: Conditional acceptance with specific manageable reservations
anchors.8: Clear acceptance of this concern with minor reservations
anchors.9: Explicit unqualified acceptance of this concern
